body: I support this feature, and the code looks good to me. I did not test it. It makes a lot of sense to import data that is semantically "here is my custom data" rather than shoe-horning custom data into further "TEXCOORD_\*" attributes. It's good to keep supporting "TEXCOORD_\*" forever so that Godot doesn't lose data from arbitrary glTF files where that data exists, but "_CUSTOM\*" as a more direct option should take priority when it exists. The name "_CUSTOM\*" is arbitrary and not in the glTF spec, but anything else would be equally arbitrary, and I think "_CUSTOM\*" is a generic enough name (not Godot-centric) that it's not at all unreasonable to see other places or assets adopt this style for arbitrary user-choice custom vertex attribute data. This PR directly overlaps with this other PR #97756 which allows custom vertex attributes to be imported in a custom way. PR #97756 is still a work-in-progress and still being discussed, but even aside from that, I think this PR is good to merge first, it's a simple improvement and a good default. The author of PR #97756 (@huwpascoe) will have to rebase their PR on top of this.
